description: Paste a NEAR error (RPC response, transaction failure, contract panic, CLI output) and get its cause and fix: matched against a catalog of common NEAR errors whose explanations are checked against docs.near.org on every sync, the deprecation entries for any API or package the error names (e.g. a removed action), and forum threads and GitHub issues that quote the same error. Needs the error text itself.

error_text.description: The error message or response, as printed.

name: explain_error
